'''Kevin Reitzel''' (Bravo Leader; anagram [[Velken Tezeri]]) finished 4th at the [[1996 Decipher World Championship]] in Vail, Colorado. He later worked in Decipher's marketing department.<ref name="kendallcast-reitzel">[https://www.kendallcast.ninja/2023/12/corran-on-horn-29-kevin-reitzel.html Corran on the Horn - 29 - Kevin Reitzel], KendallCast, 14 December 2023 (interview with "the former Decipher employee"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260421143805/https://www.kendallcast.ninja/2023/12/corran-on-horn-29-kevin-reitzel.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="bill-reitzel">Bill Bisco, confirmation that Reitzel worked for Decipher, 14 October 2026.</ref> He was Tradeshow & Event Coordinator from 1999 to 2005.<ref name="linkedin-reitzel">[https://www.linkedin.com/in/kevin-reitzel-2435996 Kevin Reitzel], LinkedIn profile, 14 October 2026 (Experience: "Tradeshow & Event Coordinator, Decipher Inc., 1999 – 2005"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261014134442/https://swccg.com/snapshots/linkedin/kevin-reitzel-2435996.html?v=dom Internet Archive] ([https://web.archive.org/web/20261014133650/https://swccg.com/snapshots/linkedin/kevin-reitzel-2435996.pdf PDF])</ref> In 2001 he was Product Champion Coordinator for ''The Lord of the Rings'' TCG.<ref name="torn-pc" /> The published fan Squadron table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run. [[Winfried Sommerfeld]] named him among the friends he made through Star Wars CCG.<ref name="decsq-sommerfeld">[http://decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/players/sommerfeldwinfried.html Star Wars CCG Squadrons: Red 41], decipher.com (page last modified 28 June 1999). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001023104822/http://decipher.com:80/volunteers/squadrons/players/sommerfeldwinfried.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.

== Other sourced notes ==

Bravo Leader at Decipher Inc. RFD broadcast 3 (18 December 1998) interviewed him with Kyle Heuer as a new marketing-team member. A fan world-finals history page lists Kevin Reitzel among the 1996 Vail world-final field (Joe Alread 3rd, Reitzel 4th). He published the 1996 pair he kept, 29 years and then 30 years on.

The anagram list unscrambles [[Velken Tezeri]] as Kevin Reitzel.

== Jedi Knights TCG ==
Reitzel is credited on Decipher's [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] team. As Product Champion for game and demo support he supplied the Product Champions with product.<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="jkpersonae">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/designdiary/personae.html Design Diary: Dramatis personae], decipher.com (2000–2001).
